name: Performance Foodservice - Kansas City (Lee's Summit MO)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open uncontrolled access from SE Thompson Dr; the truck yard has partial chain-link fencing but no barrier arm, sliding gate or checkpoint structure where the access driveway meets the public road. An internal chain-link gate exists between yard sub-zones but is not a property-line truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any entrance.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank with a red canopy along the south face; ~30 doors estimated overhead, partly obscured by trailers backed in.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large drop yard south of the dock court holds 50+ trailers and PFG box trucks in rows.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Semi-rural / edge-of-town setting — SE Thompson Dr is a narrow road with adjacent farmland, woods and scattered rural housing; classified Rural per the small-town-vs-urban tiebreak.
fieldNotes.vistar: A trailer at the dock carries Vistar branding — PFG's Vistar segment operates from this Kansas City DC alongside broadline.
